name: Not Horror: Nana Fushigi Tanteidan
original_name: NOT HORROR 七不思議探偵団
source:
Freshly moved to Daimon-machi, Tom Satou meets a mysterious young man named Kibayashi. 

Lately Tom has been troubled by something, and asks Kibayashi for advice. 
It's about this new "Seven Wonders School"... 
Tom has noticed a lot of phenomena that can only be thought of as supernatural. 
Upon hearing this, Kibayashi agrees to help Tom solve the mystery. 
Thus, the young friends begin their adventure. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142781.html]DLsite English[/url]]
